Achref Abada.note: Abada is back-line insurance for Algeria. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Achref Abada.noteZh: 他给Algeria那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Adil Boulbina.note: Boulbina is attacking depth for Algeria. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Adil Boulbina.noteZh: 他是Algeria前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Aissa Mandi.note: Mandi gives Algeria one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Aissa Mandi.noteZh: 他是Algeria无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Amine Gouiri.note: Gouiri's World Cup has already included a goal against Jordan. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Amine Gouiri.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Anis Hadj Moussa.note: Moussa is the forward Algeria can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Anis Hadj Moussa.noteZh: 他给Algeria替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Fares Chaibi.note: Chaïbi is a tempo player for Algeria. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Fares Chaibi.noteZh: 他让Algeria在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Fares Ghedjemis.note: Ghedjemis is an attacking change-up for Algeria. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Fares Ghedjemis.noteZh: 他是Algeria的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Hicham Boudaoui.note: Boudaoui gives Algeria midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Hicham Boudaoui.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Algeria来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Houssem Aouar.note: Aouar's tournament has been about supply for Algeria, especially against Austria. He sees the runner before the block finishes shifting.
Houssem Aouar.noteZh: 他已经多次为Algeria送出进球前的传球。他最好的时刻，常常来自防线还没准备好时的那一脚。

Ibrahim Maza.note: Maza is a tempo player for Algeria. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Ibrahim Maza.noteZh: 他让Algeria在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Jaouen Hadjam.note: Hadjam is defensive cover for Algeria's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Jaouen Hadjam.noteZh: 他是Algeria在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Luca Zidane.note: Zidane is the last voice in Algeria's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Luca Zidane.noteZh: 他承担了Algeria的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。

Melvin Mastil.note: Mastil gives Algeria a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Melvin Mastil.noteZh: 他在Algeria首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Mohamed Amine Tougai.note: Tougai is the kind of defender Algeria can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Mohamed Amine Tougai.noteZh: 他是Algeria艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Mohamed Amoura.note: Amoura is attacking depth for Algeria. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Mohamed Amoura.noteZh: 他是Algeria前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Nabil Bentaleb.note: Bentaleb is a tempo player for Algeria. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Nabil Bentaleb.noteZh: 他让Algeria在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Nadhir Benbouali.note: Benbouali is on the scoresheet for Algeria, with his goal coming against Jordan. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Nadhir Benbouali.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Oussama Benbot.note: Benbot gives Algeria a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Oussama Benbot.noteZh: 他在Algeria首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Rak Belghali.note: Belghali has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Austria. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Rak Belghali.noteZh: 他已经为Algeria进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Ramy Bensebaini.note: Bensebaini has been part of Algeria's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Ramy Bensebaini.noteZh: 他给Algeria后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Ramiz Zerrouki.note: Zerrouki gives Algeria midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Ramiz Zerrouki.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Algeria来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Rayan Ait-Nouri.note: Aït-Nouri has been part of Algeria's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Rayan Ait-Nouri.noteZh: 他给Algeria后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Riyad Mahrez.note: Mahrez has given Algeria both the finish and the pass, including goals against Austria. That double threat is why defenders cannot settle on one answer.
Riyad Mahrez.noteZh: 他已经把进球和助攻都放进了Algeria的赛事故事里。看点是第一脚之后，第二个动作有多快。

Samir Chergui.note: Chergui is defensive cover for Algeria's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Samir Chergui.noteZh: 他是Algeria在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Yassine Titraoui.note: Titraoui is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Algeria, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Yassine Titraoui.noteZh: 他给Algeria提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Zineddine Belaid.note: Belaïd is defensive cover for Algeria's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Zineddine Belaid.noteZh: 他是Algeria在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。
